output.answer_markdown: The passages do not say how much Pfizer expects to pay in the future to spin off Upjohn. They only report amounts already incurred or distributed: separation-related costs of $434 million in 2020 and $83 million in 2019 [1][2], $412 million of cash transferred to the Upjohn Business, and net assets of $1.6 billion distributed on November 16, 2020 [1].

found: Separation-related costs of $434 million in 2020 and $83 million in 2019, included in Discontinued operations, net of tax.
Net assets of $1.6 billion distributed on November 16, 2020, of which $412 million was cash transferred to the Upjohn Business.
missing: Any statement of expected or future payments or costs for the Upjohn spin-off.
refusal.reason: The passages give historical separation costs and distributions but no forward-looking estimate of future payments to spin off Upjohn.
